heading: Wave 15: Mapper client: canvas, tracking, scanner and authoring

briefs.focus: React 19.2.8 as installed, with no React Compiler (next.config.ts has no reactCompiler). Cover callback refs: when React re-invokes a ref callback whose identity changed (detach with null, then attach), when that happens relative to layout effects and paint, what a ref callback that returns a cleanup function changes (React then does not call it with null, which matters for forwarding to a ForwardedRef), and dev StrictMode double-invoking ref callbacks and effects. Also cover useCallback/useMemo dependency identity, a useState lazy initializer as a stable holder for a closure that reads refs, and what the eslint-plugin-react-hooks 7.1.1 rules shipped by eslint-config-next 16.3.4 (refs, immutability, set-state-in-render, exhaustive-deps) say about mutating node.style inside a ref callback and reading ref.current inside a deferred closure. Read these first: src/AGENTS.md (the runtime CSS rule), the inline-style rule in eslint.config.mjs, src/mapper/windows/MapWindow.tsx (useWindowRootRef, assignForwardedRef), src/mapper/fog/FogLayer.tsx (useFogScheduler), src/mapper/canvas/ChainLinkEdge.tsx, src/components/ui/progress-bar.tsx and its .css (CSS @starting-style for the grow-in decision).

@xyflow/react 12.11.6 with @xyflow/system 0.0.82 as installed. Read the InternalNode/InternalNodeBase types in node_modules/@xyflow/system/dist/esm/types/nodes.d.ts (internals.positionAbsolute, z, userNode, measured, width/height) to confirm that a minimal structural MeasuredNode accepts what useInternalNode() and useReactFlow().getInternalNode() return. Also read the setViewport and setCenter signatures, their Promise return, and ViewportHelperFunctionOptions (duration, ease, interpolate) in types/general.d.ts; useStore and useStoreApi with an equality function; and when EdgeLabelRenderer renders null before its portal node exists. Read these repo files first: src/mapper/canvas/use-camera-follow.ts, camera-follow-model.ts, edge-geometry.ts, ChainLinkEdge.tsx, ChainSurface.tsx, src/mapper/windows/follower-model.ts and MapWindowLayer.tsx.

@base-ui/react 1.7.0 as installed. Read node_modules/@base-ui/react/docs/react and the package type definitions; do not rely on memory. Note that src/components/ui/combobox.tsx wraps Autocomplete, not Combobox. Cover: Autocomplete Root value/onValueChange and its details.reason values including 'item-press', items with groups, filter={null}, openOnInputClick, and Enter on the Input with a highlighted item. Select Root's items label map and triggerLabel (see labelMapOf in ui/select.tsx). Toggle and ToggleGroup: multiple, value/onValueChange, aria-pressed, data-pressed and roving focus. The Dialog and Drawer popup attributes (role=dialog, data-open, hidden while exiting), and Escape handling in floating-ui-react/hooks/useDismiss.js (document listener, preventDefault, escapeKeyBubbles). Collapsible, and Menu CheckboxItem. Read these repo files first: src/components/ui/combobox.tsx, combobox-pick.ts (P039's pickOrType), terminal-search.tsx, select.tsx, portrait-toggle.tsx, drawer.tsx, dialog.tsx, stepper.tsx, src/mapper/signatures/scanner-combo-panel.tsx, scanner-scroll-dismiss.tsx, and ADOPTED_POPUP_SELECTOR in src/mapper/windows/MapWindow.tsx.

convex 1.45.0 as installed. Cover ConvexError: its data payload, why its message is the JSON of the data, and what a client useMutation promise rejects with, so a structural readConvexError (duck-typed on data.code and data.detail) matches real errors and the plain-object test mocks alike. Cover optimistic updates: OptimisticLocalStore getAllQueries/getQuery/setQuery, withOptimisticUpdate, optimisticallyUpdateValueInPaginatedQuery, insertAtTop and insertAtBottomIfLoaded, and the FunctionReference/FunctionArgs/FunctionReturnType typing that a generic loadedPages(localStore, query, mapId) over paginated queries needs. Confirm that src/lib and src/data modules imported from convex/lib bundle in the default (non-Node) runtime. Read these first: src/data/convex/use-mutation.ts, use-live-value.ts, src/mapper/chain/optimistic-authoring.ts and its test's mockStore, convex/lib/errorCode.ts, convex/lib/mapScanApply.ts, convex/mapTrackingOptIn.ts, convex/mapChainConnections.ts, convex/mapAuthoringCollapse.ts (runBranchRestore), and .claude/cloud/GUIDE.md for codegen.

Vitest 4.1.11 as installed. Tests are *.test.ts only and run in the node environment, with no jsdom (vitest.config.ts); markup comes from react-dom/server renderToStaticMarkup. Cover: vi.mock hoisting with factory and importOriginal partial mocks of 'react'; await vi.hoisted(async () => ...) for createHookRuntime; vi.stubGlobal and vi.unstubAllGlobals for requestAnimationFrame, cancelAnimationFrame, ResizeObserver, document and window; expect(promise).rejects.toBeInstanceOf; and toEqual vs toStrictEqual. Read these first: src/lib/__tests__/hook-runtime.ts (per-kind slot cursors) and source-scan.ts, src/mapper/chain/surface.test.ts (manifest and contracts), src/mapper/windows/MapWindow.input.test.ts, MapWindowLayer.card.test.ts, src/components/composition/board/HomeBoardView.focus.test.ts (useRef by slot, useEffect no-op), src/mapper/canvas/SystemIntelMarks.test.ts, the selectHandlers pattern in src/mapper/authoring/connection-fields.test.ts, and convex/__tests__/convexTest.setup.ts for P216's strict ConvexError-code assertions.

waveCautions: Mapper is one zone, but new ui homes (P044 use-style-ref.ts, P051 popup-open.ts, P028's portrait-toggle prop) may import only react, and src/lib/convex-error.ts (P217) only config: decode structurally, no convex/values. src/mapper/chain/surface.test.ts holds a sorted manifest of every non-test mapper file; update it on each add, delete or rename (P308, P109, P111, P027, P029, P030, P032, P033, P092, P139, P298) and keep its contracts: no 'convex/' imports in mapper, useMutation only in its four named files (keep useMapTrackingToggle in TrackingControls.tsx), no restoreSystem or tombstone* names outside optimistic-authoring. Conflict resolutions: P028 and P038 land as one PR; P030's connection-labels.ts is the only labels module, P092 owns scanner-optional-select.tsx, P031 drops its select step. P298 needs P072 and P032 needs P075, both not started in this tree: confirm on the base or defer. P310 must keep layout floats bit-identical. Chains: HomePrompt (P217, P028, P029, P269), follower-model and edge-geometry (P307, P055, P109, P111), connection-fields and scanner selects (P029, P030, P092, P031); P218 last. Behaviour changes needing red-to-green tests and PR notes: P028, P029, P032, P033, P044 ProgressBar grow-in, P051, P139, P217, P218. No Convex function changes, so no codegen unless a convex/ file is added. Notes left by earlier waves: P028's AFK plumbing step is already done (P059). P218's deathWindowFrom dependency is done: every death window is built through deathWindowFrom (P329). Connection door sides use ConnectionDoorSide and CONNECTION_DOOR_SIDES (P262); the wormhole codex has one code index, indexWormholeCodex, lowest typeId wins (P124).
